# Insight Integrative Health Clinic

> Insight Integrative Health Clinic is a complementary and integrative health clinic in the heart of Islington, London, with over 35 years of practice. We treat the whole person — not just the disease — combining homeopathy, acupuncture, iridology, craniosacral therapy, herbal medicine and nutritional support after a detailed individual assessment. We also supply practitioner-grade nutritional supplements.

Location: Islington, London, N1, United Kingdom.
Serving: London and surrounding areas.
Contact: https://www.insightclinic.care/ · <phone> · <email>

## Services

- [Homeopathy](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/homeopathy): Individualised homeopathic consultations for whole-person wellbeing.
- [Acupuncture](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/acupuncture): Traditional acupuncture for pain, stress, sleep, digestion and women's health.
- [Cosmetic Acupuncture](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/cosmetic-acupuncture): Facial acupuncture for skin tone and appearance.
- [Iridology](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/iridology): Iris analysis used as part of an integrative assessment.
- [Craniosacral Therapy / Cranial Rebalance](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/craniosacral): Gentle hands-on therapy supporting the body's self-regulation.
- [Herbal Medicine](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/herbal-medicine): Individually prescribed herbal support.
- [Nutritional Health](https://www.insightclinic.care/pages/nutrition): Nutritional consultations and tailored plans.
